body.name: Reachable role-state graph
body.construction: Start at \(\rho_0=(X,C)\). For every bucket \(B_j\), move the nonempty current role intersection \(B_j\cap\bar X\) from \(\bar X\) to \(\bar C\), or move \(B_j\cap\bar C\) in the reverse direction, exactly when the corresponding Chen--Mooij Rule-2 separation with regime indicator \(I_T\) holds; retain every reachable state and edge.
